mike_ml: Heads-up — planning to promote model v2.3-leasepin from shadow to a 5% canary tomorrow 10:00 PT. Goal: validate int4 latency/cost wins while monitoring quality. Known tradeoffs: int4 reduced median latency but small regression on long-context legal docs and code-complete slices. Need checklist, gating thresholds, and automatic fallback rules.

anna_reliability: +1. Suggested primary signals: p99 latency, token error rate (TER), longdoc MRR, rerank accuracy. Proposed fallback triggers:
- TER > baseline * 1.05 (i.e. +5%) sustained
- p99 > baseline + 60ms sustained
Sustained = 3 consecutive 5m windows. Both absolute and relative checks.

josh_platform: Routing plan: fractional routing with leasepin sticky sessions so users routed consistently. Minimal config sketch:
```
routes:
  canary: 0.05
  sticky_session: leasepin
  fallback: immediate
```
Will add health-check and circuit-breaker in the route.

carmen_onboarding: From quant experiments: int4 reduces token latency ~30% median and cost per-token, but we observed hallucination rate +1.2% on long legal docs when KV warm < 70%. Proposal: slice-aware gating — route long docs (seqlen>2048 or kv_warm<80%) to fp16 v2.2. Also run a short simultest: 10k seeded prompts weighted by slice.

mike_ml: Love the slice gating idea. Two safety nets to add:
1) Quiet-burn shadowing for 12h after the 5% flip (send full copies to shadow for offline eval)
2) Auto-rollback if any primary metric crosses thresholds for 3 consecutive 5-min windows (same as Anna's sustained rule)
Also require CI `canary-smoke` to pass before traffic shift.

anna_reliability: Canary-bot will emit alerts. Add these keys to rollout config:
```
rollback_window: 3  # 3 windows (5m each)
rollback_action: promote-old
alert_channel: #eng-oncall
```
I'll wire PagerDuty on trigger.

josh_platform: I'll add the routing + rollback hook and a CI job that runs 100 synthetic requests per slice: `canary-smoke`. Also will make the rollout incremental: 0.05 -> 0.2 -> 1% over 1h steps if smoke passes.

carmen_onboarding: Important: A/B eval must use identical prompt distribution and sample seed to avoid weighting drift. Use `seed=42`, and weight by slice frequency. We'll also keep an eval corpus of 5k longdocs to track MRR/hallucination.

mike_ml: Thanks. @anna_reliability @josh_platform please confirm EOD. If either blocks, escalate to @eng-oncall. I'll prepare the model bundle and the eval dashboard (compare v2.2 vs v2.3-int4).

anna_reliability: :thumbsup: Creating threshold alert + runbook now (will paste runbook section in thread).

josh_platform: On it, patching canary config and CI. PR soon.

canary-bot: Observability note: I'll start a quiet-burn shadow stream at flip and post 5-min rollup to #eng-ml. Link: https://obs.internal/redwood/canary/1753214321

mike_ml: Great. We'll reconvene after the 12h quiet-burn and the A/B eval results. Thanks everyone.
